title: Plague
summary: The Skitterdeep plague's clock (R16): the day and the toll, while it lasts.

entries.title: Day {flag.plague_day}
entries.text: {flag.plague_toll} dead in Wickermoor so far. Every Midnight Hour takes more. The cure is in Skitterdeep Mine.
The sickness has begun in Wickermoor. It will get worse at every Midnight Hour.
